headline: Eleventh Day Sees Dead Lands Bleed Heaviest as Fronts Shift
war_summary: The fighting has grown fiercer since our previous edition, and nowhere more so than the Dead Lands, where the casualty ledger has swollen past seven thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden names, losses arriving at well over a thousand an hour as the region's posts trade hands — Sun's Hollow alone changing flags three times in a day. The Wardens hold eight of its eleven bases after a night of five captures. Endless Shore remains the busiest crossing point on the map, thirty-seven base events logged around Woodbind and Saltbrook Channel, with the score standing seven Colonials to three Wardens. Fresh trouble flares elsewhere: The Fingers report new Colonial gains at Tethys Base, Stema Landing saw a Warden strike at Base Sagitta, and Stlican Shelf plus Palantine Berm both logged heavy exchanges through the small hours. By contrast, Drowned Vale's once-roiling front has gone quiet in recent readings, and Kings Cage has cooled markedly. Weathered Expanse counts enormous casualties though no base events, suggesting pressure without movement. Rear regions from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors. Thirty-four victory towns are required; none has yet fallen.
